pricing.rightPlanTitle: The right plan for every team
pricing.rightPlanSubtitle: From solo managers to enterprise construction groups — BuildStock Pro scales with your operations.
pricing.ctaTitle: Ready to transform your construction operations?
pricing.ctaSubtitle: Start with a free account. No credit card required.
pricing.faqQ1: Can I change my plan later?
pricing.faqA1: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Changes take effect immediately and billing is prorated.
pricing.faqQ2: What happens when my trial ends?
pricing.faqA2: After the 7-day trial, your account reverts to the Free plan. No credit card is required to start a trial.
pricing.faqA3: No. There are no hidden fees. You pay only the monthly or yearly subscription price.
pricing.faqA4: Yes. Cancel from your billing page with one click. You keep access until the end of your billing period.
